basic_profile.bio: Skyler is a 24-year-old non-binary individual living in Portland, Oregon. They work as a junior graphic designer at a local tech startup and have a deep passion for music and art, although they often wish they had more time to improve their skills. Skyler enjoys tinkering with tech gadgets and exploring new software. When not working or creating art, they can be found exploring the vibrant local music scene or playing video games. Skyler is currently single and spends most of their online time in the evenings after work, typically between 7 PM and 11 PM.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Skyler has a strong foundation in graphic design, having pursued a bachelor's degree in Fine Arts with a focus on digital media. They have self-taught a lot about music production and tech through online tutorials and community forums. Their interest in technology is fueled by a desire to integrate tech into their artistic pursuits.
